why_this_record_exists: A zero exit from `git push` is not evidence of publication. DIRECTLY_REPRODUCED elsewhere in this estate: two lanes committed on a shared /workspace checkout's detached HEAD, so their branch refs never advanced, and `git push -u origin <branch>` pushed the stale ref while printing 'Everything up-to-date' and exiting 0. This lane's own brief warns of exactly this: 'git push can silently no-op while exiting 0 -- confirm with git ls-remote.'

A read-back that merely names a commit is also not enough -- a fabricated read-back naming a nonexistent commit is INSTALLED_NOT_EFFECTIVE in exactly this record's own shape: a claim that passes its own check while checking nothing. So this record does not rest on asserting a SHA: it re-derives file hashes from bytes fetched back out of the remote by a clone that never saw this lane's own working tree.

method.step_2: git checkout cursor/scp-i-effective-controls-696d in the fresh clone
method.step_3: sha256 every file listed in receipts/so02/2026-08-27/scp-i/MANIFEST.json, read from the fresh clone, compared against the same path's recorded sha256/size_bytes
method.step_4: for every entry whose path ends .json, also json.loads() the bytes read from the fresh clone -- hash match alone does not prove the bytes parse
method.independence_note: /tmp/scp-i-readback shares no object store, index, or working tree with /tmp/lane-i. The comparison is between bytes the remote served and bytes this lane wrote, not between a file and itself.

observation_1_publication_is_real.what_this_rules_out: The exit-zero-on-a-stale-ref failure. A fresh clone reached this commit from the remote, so the ref genuinely advanced rather than the push silently no-opping.

observation_2_bytes_survive_the_round_tr.scope: Every file in receipts/so02/2026-08-27/scp-i/MANIFEST.json as of commit 1cb33a23: the ambient-hook probe input, the effectiveness sweep, the lane report, this lane's manifest builder, the one write declaration, and the four shared-tools files.

checked_paths: receipts/so02/2026-08-27/scp-i/MANIFEST.json (recorded self-referentially: not itself an entry, but is also read back and parsed as part of this same procedure)
observation_3_every_json_entry_parses_fr.why_this_matters: This lane's own brief names 'manifest closure mistaken for parse validity' as one of the three founding instances of INSTALLED_NOT_EFFECTIVE. Closure (path/size/hash present) is a shape check; a byte-truncated file can still close. Every structured artifact this lane delivers is therefore hash-checked AND parsed, from the fresh clone, not just from the local working tree that produced it.

why_no_per_file_hash_list_is_duplicated_.statement: Per-file hashes live in MANIFEST.json and are deliberately not copied into this record.
why_no_per_file_hash_list_is_duplicated_.reason: This record is written after MANIFEST.json's first build but before the final manifest rebuild that includes this record itself. Copying a hash list here would go stale the moment this record is added as a manifest entry in the next commit.
why_no_per_file_hash_list_is_duplicated_.single_authority: MANIFEST.json holds path, size_bytes and sha256 for every delivered file, including this record once the manifest is rebuilt to cover it, plus entry_count and a bundle_sha256 a third party recomputes independently.

this_record_is_a_manifest_entry_not_an_e: Per this lane's own MANIFEST.json (closure.read_back_record_is_covered), this file is included the next time build_manifest.py runs, exactly as receipts/so02/2026-08-22/oe-w5-agentic-office/MANIFEST.json covers its own READ-BACK-20260822-v001.json. It is not declared as an excluded file.

the_closing_check_a_reviewer_should_run.statement: This record and the final MANIFEST.json cannot appear in a clone taken before the commit that carries them. The regress is closed by running the check against the final branch head, where every file including this one is present.
the_closing_check_a_reviewer_should_run.expected: PASS, with entry_count and bundle_sha256 recomputed from the remote's own bytes. That single command supersedes this record: it verifies every delivered file, including this one, from a clone that never saw the producing runtime.

what_this_record_does_not_establish: That the wrapper, the prober, or the regression are correct in some absolute sense -- only that the bytes delivered are the bytes this record and the test runs in LANE-I-REPORT.md describe, byte-identically, from an independent clone.
That any claim in LANE-I-REPORT.md was independently validated by a party other than this lane.
That the manifest's own bytes are verified by this record. The manifest is verified by the commit that carries it and by its own --check, run here from the fresh clone as observation 2 and 3 above.
